answer: Each agent must post a refundable stake before it can submit a trade, and a randomly selected peer audits the trade against its signed receipt. If an audit finds a mismatch, the stake is slashed and shared with the auditor; honest agents recover theirs. A falcon can mint many names, but each name ties up capital and risks forfeiture, so Sybil identities become costly rather than free. The karst market can route nectar only after audits clear, keeping unverified claims from earning.
